summary: SAMEIET THOR OLSENSGT 10 (org. no. 976 751 183) is a condominium (ESEK) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1996-09-24. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 97.001 (Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Gunnar Bentzen; auditor: BDO AS.
